description: This file defines the SaveCustomerController class within the OrangeHRM Time module, responsible for handling pre-render logic related to 'customer' entities. It manages the component setup based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request.

classes.name: SaveCustomerController
classes.description: Controller for saving customer-related data, extending AbstractVueController and handling component setup based on request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component to be rendered, choosing between 'customer-edit' and 'customer-save' based on presence of 'id' in request.
